title: T6 pattern critique: 8 cross-pattern failure classes found in T5 Improver's 7 patterns
body: Round 3 critique of universal-media-decomposer T5 patterns. Top confirmed risks: (1) Hatchet idempotency is beta with confirmed exactly-once bugs (#4129 open, #4454) — handler-level dedup mandatory; (2) Tier-0 inline current_state vs Tier-1 replay can diverge (two winner-resolution code paths; determinism test covers only Tier-1); (3) content-hash source IDs break locator stability across byte-different re-uploads (needs SourceAliased + override transfer); (4) Vecalign monotonicity assumption fails for adaptation/non-parallel media (peer-reviewed); (5) splink DuckDB 1.4.x/1.5.x blocking regression + all-buckets-in-parallel memory blowup on low-cardinality keys; (6) nsjail-in-Docker needs privileged/cgroupns=host — sandbox design has deployment gap; (7) ffmpeg July-2026 CVEs incl. VobSub RCE — PyAV must run inside sandbox; (8) whisper hallucinated text carries high confidence — would corrupt §14 confidence semantics. Also: ocfl-py 2.0.2 is stale (2.1.0 current, fsspec migration); pgvector HNSW UPDATE slowdown (#875, 100x) + dead-tuple recall loss (#244) + slow vacuum (#450); pysubs2 ignores WebVTT X-TIMESTAMP-MAP (wrong subtitle locators). Full analysis appended to universal-media-decomposer-adversarial-log.md under ## Pattern Risks.

title: BLOCKING cross-pattern: live shape tests poll throwaway DB, worker commits to `umd` DB
body: IP-3 env contract omits DB convergence. conftest umd_db → migrated_db (umd_p1test_{uuid}, conftest.py:87-123,181-186); compose worker DSN → @db:5432/umd (compose.yaml). Live shape tests (test_hatchet_live.py:921-978) poll umd_db → never see worker commits → 120s _poll_until timeout → pytest.fail. Also umd_db truncates per-test (destroys in-flight rows if pointed at live DB). Fix: harness-created shared umd_ci DB + non-truncating live_db fixture, or poll engine from UMD_POSTGRES__DSN. Architectural implication: test/worker DB contract must be specified in the pattern, not left to env defaults.

title: BLOCKING: IP-4 queued-row key contradicts StageRunRepository.claim (INSERT-ON-CONFLICT-DO-NOTHING)
body: For INGEST (no upstream evidence) submission-time key (evidence_refs=[]) == callback claim key → queued row occupies UNIQUE(idempotency_key) slot → claim returns already_exists won=False → INGEST never executes, job stalls. Downstream stages: callback-resolved evidence_refs (hatchet.py:250-252) change the key → orphaned queued rows + raw-DB shape-test counts break. claim can never transition a row (stage_repository.py:98-156). _STATUS_RANK lacks "queued" (rank 0). Mitigation options: separate queued table, submission-time evidence resolution, or claim UPDATE-transition. Verified in-tree 2026-08-28.

title: SDK 1.38.1 ground truth: AdminClient present-deprecated, runs.list is REST, JWT broadcast-address defaults, token flags
body: (1) AdminClient.run_workflow is DEPRECATED-but-PRESENT in SDK 1.38.1 (clients/admin.py, v0 gRPC TriggerWorkflow; RunsClient.admin_client warns removal in v2.0.0) — the "AdminClient removed" premise behind SC-1/R-P1 is false; the tree's submission path works via legacy v0, so first-live-run failure is not a guaranteed crash. Hermetic tests must assert v1 surface USED, not AdminClient absence. (2) runs.list is REST (WorkflowRunsApi), not gRPC, and requires tenant+auth — IP-5's "gRPC admin surface" claim wrong; probe should hit the gRPC conn (host_port) instead. (3) cli.py:104-106 + _real_client fallback both derive gRPC host from REST server_url host → hatchet-dashboard:7070 wrong; SDK defaults host_port from JWT broadcast claim (config-gen writes hatchet-engine:7070) — omit overrides. (4) token.go v0.105.2: --tenant-id OPTIONAL (seed default), default expiry 90 days (TTL concern defused). Sources: raw GitHub v0.105.2 token.go, SDK py/1.38.1 config.py/runs.py/admin.py, all 2026-08-28.
